verses.en: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.pt: O SENHOR reina; que a terra se encha de alegria; alegrem-se as muitas ilhas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is King, let the earth have joy; let all the sea-lands be glad.

verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.pt: Nuvens e escuridão há ao redor dele; justiça e juízo são a base de seu trono.
verses.en_web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.en_bbe: Dark clouds are round him; his kingdom is based on righteousness and right judging.

verses.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.pt: Fogo vai adiante dele, que inflama seus adversários ao redor.
verses.en_web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
verses.en_bbe: Fire goes before him, burning up all those who are against him round about.

verses.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.pt: Seus relâmpagos iluminam o mundo; a terra os vê, e treme.
verses.en_web: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
verses.en_bbe: His bright flames give light to the world; the earth saw it with fear.

verses.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.pt: Os montes se derretem como cera na presença do SENHOR, na presença do Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.en_bbe: The mountains became like wax at the coming of the Lord, at the coming of the Lord of all the earth.

verses.en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.pt: Os céus anunciam sua justiça, e todos os povos veem sua glória.
verses.en_web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.en_bbe: The heavens gave out the news of his righteousness, and all the people saw his glory.

verses.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
verses.pt: Sejam envergonhados todos os que servem a imagens, e os que se orgulham de ídolos; prostrai-vos diante dele todos os deuses.
verses.en_web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
verses.en_bbe: Shamed be all those who give worship to images, and take pride in false gods; give him worship, all you gods.

verses.en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.pt: Sião ouviu, e se alegrou; e as filhas de Judá tiveram muita alegria, por causa de teus juízos, SENHOR;
verses.en_web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Zion gave ear and was glad; and the daughters of Judah were full of joy, because of your decisions, O Lord.

verses.en: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.pt: Pois tu, SENHOR, és o Altíssimo sobre toda a terra; tu és muito mais elevado que todos os deuses.
verses.en_web: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.en_bbe: For you, Lord, are most high over the earth; you are lifted up over all other gods.

verses.en: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.pt: Vós que amais ao SENHOR: odiai o mal; ele guarda a alma de seus santos, e os resgata da mão dos perversos.
verses.en_web: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: You who are lovers of the Lord, be haters of evil; he keeps the souls of his saints; he takes them out of the hand of sinners.

verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.pt: A luz é semeada para o justo, e a alegria para os corretos de coração.
verses.en_web: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.en_bbe: Light is shining on the lovers of righteousness, and for the upright in heart there is joy.

verses.en: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.pt: Vós justos, alegrai-vos no SENHOR; e agradecei em memória de sua santidade. Salmo:
verses.en_web: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.en_bbe: Be glad in the Lord, you upright men; praising the memory of his holy name.
